name: Session Summary
description: See the outcome of the active agent session or the shared summary of its worktree.

settings.title: Show plugin icon on Settings button
settings.description: Hide the plugin mark to show just the settings gear. The sidebar tab is unchanged.

settings.title: Show outcome from local history
settings.description: If no saved session summary exists, show the last substantive reply from that completed session.

settings.title: Auto-open for new worktrees
settings.description: Show the panel when a newly created worktree has a saved summary.

settings.title: Enable workflow profile actions
settings.description: Show actions only for a project matching one of your enabled profiles.
